milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange bed foot is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 3), ~5.8 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk toward the bed (closing at least ~0.8 blocks from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the bed, modeling 'player has found and is observing the bed'.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dandelion always drops the dandelion item into the player's inventory (instant break, no tool required, always drops itself). The dandelion is at spawn-relative (~3, 0, 2) near the bed. Player needs at least 1 dandelion in inventory to confirm they mined it.

Uses inventory_has because slime blocks always drop themselves when broken (no special tool required). The slime blocks are at spawn-relative (~7-8, 1, 3) on the front face of the enclosed oak structure. Player needs at least 1 slime_block in inventory to confirm they mined it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because gray stained glass panes do NOT drop as items when broken without Silk Touch (player only has a wooden pickaxe). Therefore inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we verify the glass pane blocks have been destroyed by checking that zero gray_stained_glass_pane blocks remain in a generous bounding box around their placement location (spawn-relative ~7-8, 1, 4). Box [6,0,3] to [9,3,6] generously covers the entire structure interior.
